_comment: CLIP zero-shot prompt catalogue. Each prompt is a natural-language label scored by the CLIP model; a top-scoring prompt writes (feature, value) into the image feature snapshot for phenotype matching. feature/value pairs are validated against ImageNGP.json at startup. Edit to add or retune prompts without recompiling.

prompts.prompt: a photo of a person wearing clothing
a product photo with no person, ghost mannequin or flat lay
a front view of the product
a back view of the product
a side view of the product
a top down view of the product
a three-quarter or diagonal view of the product
a photo showing the full face of the model
a photo showing a partially visible face
a photo with no visible face or head
a photo showing the full body of the model
a photo showing three quarters of the body
a photo showing only the upper half of the body
a photo showing only the bust or chest of the model
